title: Sample narrator auditions
intro: Three placeholder voices that use every part of the page. Each voice reads the same text. Play a take with the film's music under it, or the voice alone. This sample ships no audio, so a play button reports the missing take.
sample: This is the text every voice reads. It is two sentences long.

voices.name: Voice two
voices.description: A warmer reader at a slower pace.

voices.name: Voice three
voices.description: The voice the films use now.

notes: Pace is words a second at the voice's natural speed.
Steadiness is the median frame-to-frame pitch change in percent. A lower number means a steadier voice.
